characters.name: 秦九镰
characters.subject: a powerfully built Chinese woman in her late forties, veteran scavenger and hard-edged quartermaster of Hanging Hook Hall, charcoal and rust-brown layered work clothes, worn descent harness, soot-stained leather and heavy salt-iron buckles, her left arm missing below the elbow and ending in a rough purely functional forged iron hook prosthesis with no gears, her intact right hand pinning a descent commission sheet beneath an old iron balance-weight paperweight, weathered face, dark hair streaked with grey and tied back, shrewd stern eyes with protective concern held behind a hard assessing expression, Hanging Hook Hall ledgers, chains, hooks and capstan fading into soft ash haze behind her

characters.name: 温辞
characters.subject: a slender Chinese man around thirty, young vice-minister of the Helm Court and keeper of anchor writs, formally bound dark hair, austere layered ink-blue and ash-grey official robes adapted to a harsh shell-city, a weathered night-watch cloak fastened by a modest oxidized-bronze anchor clasp, holding a compact official seal box with dark red sealing wax, precise upright posture, intelligent critical eyes and a sharply controlled expression concealing exhaustion and fear, high watchtower, warning bells, taut anchor lines and drifting dawn ash behind him, practical overworked bureaucrat rather than royalty

characters.name: 哑弦
characters.subject: a lean weathered Chinese man in his early forties, silent cold-scale broker, refugee-descendant and underground informant, carefully maintained patched layers in faded indigo, charcoal and bone-grey, closed mouth and watchful unreadable eyes, cradling a traditional sanxian lute wrapped with old pale turtle scales, one hand poised on the strings as if speaking through a warning chord, a tiny scale-testing balance peeking from his sleeve, hidden Eaves Market between massive anchor posts, dull cold scales in shadow with sparse cyan glints, restrained loyalty beneath constant caution, no stage-performer flamboyance
